uac.confirmBody: Their app follows on its next request.
uac.offNote: Turned off: out of this business in every app, and their stores are cleared so the old app shows them nothing too. Turning them back on means picking their stores again.
uac.ownerNote: The owner always keeps full access.
uac.blockNote: Reject: they can ask again. Block: their later asks are dropped, and they aren't told.
uac.helpOneAccount: One account, a level per app
uac.helpOneAccountBody:
Everyone signs in with their own Google account.
Each app gives them its own level.
Being in the seller app says nothing about the office.
uac.helpSellerBody:
Member: uses the seller app (POS, orders) in their stores.
None: cannot open it.
uac.helpOfficeBody:
Admin: sees and changes everything, and gives others access.
Guest: sees everything, changes nothing.
None: cannot open it.
uac.helpOwnerBody:
Always an admin in every app.
Nobody can turn the owner off or lower their levels.
uac.helpStoresBody:
Which stores someone sees in the seller app.
Set per person, apart from their levels.
uac.helpInactiveBody:
Out of every app in this business from their next tap.
Their stores are cleared.
Turning them back on means picking their stores again.
uac.helpRequestsBody:
Someone who opens an app here without access can ask to join.
Their request waits at the top of UAC.
An admin lets them in (with levels and stores) or rejects it.
uac.blockBody: Their later asks are dropped, and they aren't told.
